<!-- Steps -->
<div id="step1" class="box">✅ Step 1: Solve auxiliary eq. for complementary solution</div>

<div id="step2" class="box"> Step 2: A)Use annihilator or B)substitution method</div>
<div id="step3" class="box">📌 Step 3A: Find annihilator and solve it</div>
<div id="step4" class="box">📌 Step 3B: Assume a particular solution based on RHS rules</div>
<div id="step5" class="box">🧠 Step 4–5: Differentiate yₚ and substitute → compare coefficients</div>
<div id="step6" class="box">✅ Final Step: General Solution → y = y_c + y_p</div>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // Main downward flow
    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step1'), document.getElementById('step2'), {
      color: '#888',
      path: 'grid',
      startPlug: 'behind',
      endPlug: 'arrow3',
      size: 2
    });

    // Branch step 3A
    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step2'), document.getElementById('step3'), {
      color: '#2196f3',
      path: 'grid',
      startPlug: 'behind',
      endPlug: 'arrow3',
      size: 2
    });

    // Branch step 3B
    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step2'), document.getElementById('step4'), {
      color: '#2196f3',
      path: 'grid',
      startPlug: 'behind',
      endPlug: 'arrow3',
      size: 2
    });

    // Merge to step 5
    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step3'), document.getElementById('step5'), {
      color: '#888',
      path: 'arc',
      size: 2
    });

    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step4'), document.getElementById('step5'), {
      color: '#888',
      path: 'arc',
      size: 2
    });

    // Final arrow
    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step5'), document.getElementById('step6'), {
      color: '#4db6ac',
      path: 'grid',
      endPlug: 'arrow3',
      size: 2
    });
  });
</script>
